description: This file defines the BesselY class which provides methods to compute Bessel functions of the second kind (Neumann functions) for engineering calculations, including handling array inputs and special cases.

classes.name: BesselY
classes.description: Provides static methods to calculate Bessel functions of the second kind (Neumann functions) for engineering calculations.

methods.name: BESSELY
methods.description: Calculates the Bessel function of the second kind for a given value and order, handling array inputs and errors.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Handles special cases for order 0 and 1, otherwise computes the BesselY for higher orders.

methods.name: callBesselJ
methods.description: Calls the BesselJ function and ensures the result is a float, used internally.

methods.name: besselY0
methods.description: Computes the BesselY function of order 0 for a given x.

methods.name: besselY1
methods.description: Computes the BesselY function of order 1 for a given x.

methods.name: besselY2
methods.description: Computes the BesselY function of order n (>1) for a given x using recurrence relation.
